notes: Recorded 113 bachelor's, 353 master's and 233 doctoral rows from 11 universities. This is NOT the full CSC catalogue: the CSC's own Study in China portal sits behind a browser check and no national list was readable, so only majors from university-published lists that were opened are recorded. The same major appears once per university (and once per level).

Universities covered, with rows (all levels): Beihang University 10; Beijing Language and Culture University 71; Changchun University of Science and Technology 39; Changsha University of Science and Technology 2; China University of Petroleum (Beijing) 38; Hunan University 8; Northeast Normal University 123; Shanghai Jiao Tong University 77; Shanghai University of Finance and Economics 16; Sun Yat-sen University 313; Zhejiang University of Technology 4.

Route matters: Sun Yat-sen University and Beijing Language and Culture University list majors for Type A (the bilateral, embassy route); Hunan University, Northeast Normal University, China University of Petroleum (Beijing), Changchun University of Science and Technology, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and Shanghai Jiao Tong University publish Type B (university route) lists; Beihang University and Changsha University of Science and Technology list Silk Road / Belt and Road programmes. Each row's detail text says which list it comes from.

Northeast Normal University: the list marks which scholarships each major takes in tick columns that did not survive text extraction, so a row means the major is in the list attached to the CGS notice, not that each tick was confirmed.

Shanghai Jiao Tong University: only the English-taught master's and doctoral lists were recorded (distinct major names). The Chinese-taught master's and doctoral lists (14 and 8 pages) were downloaded but their wrapped multi-column tables could not be read reliably, so they are not recorded; two partly cut-off entries in the English lists were left out.

Hunan University: the notice names only the majors taught in both languages; Chinese-taught majors sit on the university graduate school site, which was not read. China University of Petroleum (Beijing): its page says all postgraduate programmes take part in the High-Level Postgraduate Program, so all programmes in its two PDF lists are recorded.

Zhejiang University of Technology: the main major lists are images and could not be read; only four Chinese-taught undergraduate programmes named in the page text are recorded. Shanghai University of Finance and Economics: the list says more majors are on its Graduate School site.
Bachelor's applicants need a CSCA score (subjects depend on the university); the BLCU list gives the subjects per major.
not_stated: No national or per-country list of majors in the embassy notices read (Poland, Ireland, United States, Indonesia, Canada)

Whether every major in a university list is open to scholarship holders: only China University of Petroleum (Beijing) states 'all postgraduate programmes' and Sun Yat-sen University's list is titled as the Bilateral Program list

Zhejiang University of Technology major lists are images; Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University and Beijing Foreign Studies University pages did not give a readable major list (links lead to portal pages or catalogues not opened).
Shanghai Jiao Tong University Chinese-taught lists and the Tianjin University undergraduate CSCA list (Chinese text lost in extraction) could not be read reliably.
